Before 380 CE, Christianity had gone from a persecuted sect to a tolerated faith under Constantine. But it still shared space with paganism, philosophy, and pluralism. One of the most dangerous shifts was that wrong belief equaled crime. Heresy was no longer just disagreement, it was a threat to the state.
